headline.text: L3 ML4 ingredient tank improperly installed after washing with *damaged gasket* — caught before production start.

summary: Three equipment and process gaps across L1 and L3 — all caught during pre-production checks or by operators mid-run. No product on hold at window close.

food_safety.title: ML4 ingredient tank improperly assembled after cleaning
food_safety.summary: Ingredient 1 tank found incorrectly installed post-wash with damaged gasket during pre-production inspection — caught before product contact, line had not started.
food_safety.status: Caught during startup troubleshooting before ML4 began production — packaging team sent home, no product made.

quality.title: S2 wrong recipe settings discovered mid-run
quality.summary: Recipe still set to Allfill and Matrixes parameters instead of current product — line stopped, accumulation passed, restarted with correct settings.
quality.status: Resolved — line stopped, accumulation cleared, correct recipe loaded and production resumed.

sanitation.title: ML4 Depositor 1 failed visual inspection after cleaning
sanitation.summary: Depositor 1 did not pass visual inspection on first attempt — EEs went over areas needing additional cleaning, re-inspected and passed before loading.
sanitation.status: Resolved — re-cleaned, passed visual and ATP by 04:34, molds loaded and line started at 06:05.

opportunities.text: Review recipe change protocol for S2 line — recipe still set to previous product (Allfill/Matrixes) when current run started, caught mid-shift by operator.

Consider adding post-cleaning assembly verification checklist for ML4 ingredient tanks — today's improperly installed tank with damaged gasket was caught by operator inspection during troubleshooting rather than a formal check.
